thread:
Maria Chen: I'm doing the handoff for the night shift — I'm primary until 22:00 UTC then Ajay will take primary, Samir as secondary. Leaving notes below.

Maria Chen: Current open things: cluster autoscale alert in us-west-2 (low), one PD incident for degraded search (investigating), Grafana dashboard 'prod/latency' has intermittent spikes.

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-872 — PagerDuty alert triggered (search-service — P2).

oncall-bot: Escalation policy: oncall-night -> primary -> secondary.

Ajay Patel: ack. Are both Ajay and Samir confirmed to have PagerDuty and AWS console access? Last handoff we had an issue with a missing PD role.

Maria Chen: Samir and I confirmed PD access earlier today. Ajay, I saw you had an SSO role change — can you confirm you can escalate from PD and see full incident details?

Ajay Patel: quick check — I can see incidents but I can't trigger 'force notify' (button is greyed out). Looks like I don't have PD 'Responder' role on that service.

Maria Chen: hmm. If PD role is missing you won't be able to escalate directly. Samir, can you do escalation if needed?

Samir Khan: I can. But let's try to fix Ajay now, should be quick: admin needs to add you to the "oncall-night" schedule or the service-level responder group. I don't have admin perms to change PD groups.

Lee Wong: tagging infra-admins — @infra-admins can someone grant Ajay the PD responder role for search-service? We need this done before handoff at 22:00 UTC.

infra-admins: noted — can confirm in ~10m. Also reminder: confirm Grafana org role. We had a case where dashboards were blocked by viewer-only permissions.

Ajay Patel: thanks. While infra-admins is on it, quick access checklist I'm missing (copying here):
- PagerDuty responder access to service -> needed to escalate
- AWS Console ReadOnly + sts:AssumeRole to 'redwood-oncall' role for emergency ops
- Grafana 'Editor' on prod org to add annotations and view internal panels
- Access to KMS audit logs (read) if investigating encrypted payload errors

Maria Chen: good checklist. For AWS, if you need to assume the role:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall 
--role-session-name handoff-test
```
Make sure MFA is available on your SSO session.

Samir Khan: also, Grafana URL: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/PROD/latency and runbook for oncall: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall/handoff (see section 'permissions & quick fixes').

incident-bot: paging summary — 1 active PD incident, 3 low-priority alerts in infra, no customer pages yet.

Maria Chen: note on the search-service incident: customer impact is currently 'degraded results' for a subset of traffic. PD notes show 12% error rate on rerank calls. Runbook to follow remediation steps under 'search-service/retries-and-queues'.

Ajay Patel: infra-admins updated PD role and I can now see 'force notify' — confirmed. Thanks.

infra-admins: Ajay added to oncall-night responder group and granted Grafana Editor role (email audit: 3498765600). Confirmed AWS role binding exists, but you might need to re-login to SSO to pick it up.

Ajay Patel: re-logged SSO, can assume role, can see Grafana panels and annotate. Good to go.

Maria Chen: great. Two quick mitigation pointers for tonight (copying from runbook):
1) If error rate >20% escalate to P1 and page SEs immediately. Use PD runbook 'search-service -> escalate' (steps + owners).
2) If Grafana panels are missing metrics, check the /metrics-forwarder logs on infra-vm-3 and restart service:
```
sudo systemctl restart metrics-forwarder && journalctl -u metrics-forwarder -f --since "5m"
```

Samir Khan: I'm noting this in my personal handoff doc. Also leaving my mobile as backup: +1-555-0199 if PD fails (please only use for P1).

Maria Chen: handing off now. Ajay you're primary at 22:00 UTC, Samir you're secondary. If anyone notices access regress during the shift ping here immediately and @oncall-bot will create a quick JIT access request.

Ajay Patel: taking primary. I'll monitor PD and Grafana for the next 12h. Thanks Maria.

Samir Khan: standing by as secondary.

Maria Chen: done — signing off. :wave:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Ajay Patel, secondary=Samir Khan, handed_off_by=Maria Chen, handoff_ts=3498766800

oncall-bot: If access issues occur run `/oncall-jit-request <username> <reason>` to request temporary elevation (expires 2h).
